_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Remove the unsupported Moshi notification claims.**

The five-minute path reaches the local `Event` channel and Shell UI only. `Shell::push` stores events locally, while Question handling and completion use `herdr` for answer delivery. The inspected HTTP and integration paths do not send Moshi or phone notifications. Following this guide therefore cannot produce the promised phone alerts.

<details><summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-When a Question has waited 5 minutes unanswered, the Shell goes On call and
-rings your phone through [Moshi](https://getmoshi.app). The minutes are set on
+When a Question has waited 5 minutes unanswered, the Shell goes On call. The
+minutes are set on
 the On call page of `/config`. When On call starts, every Question already
-waiting is pushed once. While it is on, every Question after it and the end of
-the run are pushed to the phone at once. The status row shows ON CALL.
+waiting is shown in the Shell. The status row shows ON CALL.
...
-Nothing rings if the Mac sleeps or the Shell is closed: the Shell is what pushes.
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
When a Question has waited 5 minutes unanswered, the Shell goes On call. The
minutes are set on
the On call page of `/config`. When On call starts, every Question already
waiting is shown in the Shell. The status row shows ON CALL.

You answer in the Shell, from the phone over SSH. Answering any Question ends
On call. The next Question rings only after it has itself waited the minutes.

Nothing parks for On call: a Stage's question waits and rings. `/away` wins:
turning Away on ends On call, and under Away nothing rings and the Shell never
goes On call. On call is off each time the Shell opens, and stays off while it
has no token.
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Remove the Moshi setup instructions until the feature exists.**

`orqa init` does not prompt for a Moshi token. `/config` has no On call page, and no `MOSHI_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` or test-push path exists. A user following these steps cannot configure or test Moshi On call. The specific token-storage and permission claims are also unsupported; only the TypeSafe key has an implemented `.orqadence-local` storage contract.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-## Moshi
-
-1. Install the Moshi app on your phone.
-2. In Moshi, open Settings > Notifications and copy the webhook token.
-3. Give the token to Orqadence, one of three ways:
-   - `orqa init` asks "Ring your phone through Moshi when a Question waits?".
-     Say yes and paste the token.
-   - In the Shell, open `/config`, go to the On call page and type the token.
-   - Set `MOSHI_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` in the environment the Shell runs in (wins over
-     the saved token).
-4. On the On call page of `/config`, pick "Send a test push". The phone should
-   ring almost at once.
```

</details>
